name: bergner-skills
description: Herman Bergner's public marketplace of reusable Claude Code agent skills.

plugins.name: claude-code-handover
plugins.description: The house format for handing a discrete task to a Claude Code agent — front-loaded context, explicit scope boundaries, verify gates, and guardrails.

plugins.name: plan-format
plugins.description: The house format for a phased implementation/design plan — TL;DR, recorded decisions, first-class security requirements, one-PR-each tasks, devil's-advocate, handoff.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: The house pull-request discipline — one task = one PR opened not merged, every line traces to the request, scope creep flagged, verification and security reviewed first-class.

plugins.name: repo-doc-standard
plugins.description: The platform's standard for how a repository documents itself — README vs ARCHITECTURE/design vs runbooks, how they cross-reference, and the conventions that keep docs current.
